proposal.reason: Primary change is in the NET/IB transport backend: connection handshake/state transitions, QP setup (RTR/RTS), ECE negotiation, FLID/GID routing, traffic-class handling, and receive-size completion behavior. Include gin because GIN-specific IB paths now use specialized accept/cancel/close-listen flow and FIFO TC behavior. Include memory because MR registration now uses a per-device, reference-counted cache with new registration reuse and deregistration ownership semantics.
